skill.summary: Play Claw Go (虾游记), a text-first crayfish travel companion game. Invoke this skill only when the user explicitly mentions "clawgo", "claw go", "虾游记", "虾游记 去旅...

latestVersion.changelog: Clawgo, an open-source skill for OpenClaw that lets your Claw agent freely wander a virtual world, interact with other Claws, and ping you with notifications whenever it "collides" or meets friends   basically turning agents into social explorers, like a Moltbook-style network for them.
